What is on it: A vast rectangular hall of riveted iron ribs and pale glass panes fills the view, daylight falling through its long roof to a colossal chimney tower of dark iron that rises above every surrounding rooftop. Inside the hall a huge engine of iron stands at the centre, ringed by pressure gauges on piped stands. A boiler and a coal store heaped with black coal sit against one wall, and an overhead gantry crane on raised rails spans the engine from end to end. A platform lift with an iron cage occupies one corner. On the street side tall iron gates open the wall, and beside them a walled dock with tram rails meets the building. The ground: indoors.
